mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as cdCName, c1.C_Abbreviation as cdCAbbName, dtl.* from Pc_Claim_Dtl dtl left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=dtl.Cd_C_Id where dtl.Claim_Id=#{claimId}

select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as claimFpName, c2.C_Name as claimSpName, c1.C_Abbreviation as claimFpAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as claimSpAbbName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Pc_Claim mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.Claim_Fp left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Claim_Sp left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Claim_Id where mn.Claim_Id=#{claimId}
